name: Pierce Camp Birchmont
description_short: A family-owned co-ed overnight camp for ages 7 to 15 on Lake Wentworth in Wolfeboro, NH, with 30-plus activities across aquatics, athletics, arts and adventure. Families choose a 7-week full season, a 4- or 3-week session, or a 2-week introductory session for first-timers or campers in grades 1-3.

sources.note: Tuition is all-inclusive, with round-trip transport from the NY metro area and Logan Airport; sibling discounts 5% and 10%

source.title: Kids New Hampshire Summer Camp: Wolfeboro, NH: Camp Birchmont

special_needs_notes: Nut-safe kitchen with no nut products or oils; vegetarian options at every meal, and gluten-free and kosher-style menus can be accommodated.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Lake Wentworth (state Class A water, sandy bottom, little boat traffic) with nearly half a mile of private sandy beach. Campers can join swim meets and sailing regattas.
